latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Free Export — fast, no-subscription AI editing with free MP4 export.

- Instantly edit and export up to 2-minute video clips as 1080p MP4s without a paid account
- Automated session and token management: on first run, skill auto-acquires a 7-day, 100-credit anonymous token
- Upload, edit, and export using natural language instructions—no manual timelines or export settings
- All editing and rendering handled securely via cloud GPU; supports popular video, audio, and image formats
- Actions for export, credits, upload, and session status mapped directly from user intent
- Handles errors, credits, large file limits, and provides step-by-step feedback throughout the workflow
